ar, and pin workspaces to the top.
# Workspace Archive
`@local/dsh-workspace-archive` 0.2.1, a plain-JavaScript DSH Web / Desktop plugin with no build step
@local/dsh-workspace-archive` 0.2.1, a plain-JavaScript DSH Web / Desktop plugin with no build step.
Archive or restore a workspace's conversations in one action. **Once all real conversations are arch
ived, the entire workspace disappears from the sidebar, including its blank New Session entry.** It
remains available in the Workspace Archive management panel. Restoring any real conversation shows i
t again. Workspace pinning is also supported.
## Usage
Open the archive icon in the sidebar. The panel shows each workspace's path, session counts, Archive
all, Restore all, pin controls, and an expandable conversation list. A hidden workspace carries a H
idden from sidebar tag. Session row menus also offer workspace archive and pin actions.
Archive requests ask for confirmation. Running sessions are skipped by default; work stops only when
the operator explicitly selects Also stop running sessions or the corresponding retry action. A flo
ating progress card permits panel navigation and cancellation of remaining work. Results report fail
ures and offer an undo action.
## Visibility and restoration
- A workspace with real conversation history is hidden when all that history is archived. Blank plac

eholders and subagents do not prevent hiding.
- Unarchived conversations, including skipped running

sessions, failed archive calls, or unfinished cancelled batches, keep the workspace visible.
- Empty

and blank-only workspaces remain available for starting work.
- Visibility derives from the Host's
durable archive set, so it survives reloads and applies to workspaces archived by older plugin versi

ons without another archive action.
- Hidden sessions do not reappear under Ungrouped, flat browsing
, or sidebar search. Sidebar archive filters do not show the hidden workspace; use this plugin's pan

el to restore it.
- Restore any real conversation to show the workspace again, or Restore all to res

tore its group. Individually archived blanks remain restorable too.
- Workspace registrations, logs,
directories, membership, and saved workspace expansion/manual order are retained. Hiding a parent d
oes not archive separately registered child workspaces.
## Pinning
Pins use the Host's `workspaces.insertBefore` reorder and keep the pinned block ahead of new workspa
ces and manual moves. The most recent pin leads; unpinning places a workspace below the remaining pi
nned block. Order is Host-durable, while pin membership is browser-local under `dsh.workspace-archiv
e.pinned-workspaces`. Controls are hidden when the reorder API is unavailable.
## Installation and updates
Install this directory through the DSH plugin manager. The manifest's `dsh.bundle.patch` points to `
cordis.patch.yml`, inserting the `workspace-archive` row. The Host entry has no business behavior; a
rchive operations still use `uiWorkspace.archiveSession/unarchiveSession`.
Use the manager's `application` and `nextStep` results to determine whether an update is live. Sourc
e edits alone do not imply an existing browser has reloaded the code. Refresh the current DSH page a
fter updating; restart Desktop first when the manager requires it.
## Compatibility and rollback
The 0.2.1 sidebar contract was checked against DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. That version exposes neither a worksp
ace visibility filter nor an official occupant-wrapper API. The isolated `installSidebarFilter` comp
atibility adapter wraps the live `sidebar.workspaces` entry's component and filters only its workspa
ce/session props. The entry's existing children, store, inject face, locale, and actions remain in p
lace. It does not redeclare children, import Harness Client packages, or read/write other plugins' D
e. It does not redeclare children, import Harness Client packages, or read/write other plugins' DOM.
This depends on the mutable entry representation, **not a Host-guaranteed stable filter extension po
int**; Host upgrades need regression verification. The adapter follows the declaration lifetime thro
ugh `slots.inject`, observes entry replacement, and restores the original component when unloaded. T
he management panel keeps the full snapshots. Disabling the plugin removes workspace hiding but leav
es session archive records intact.

nk placeholders, partial archives, missing summaries, loading baselines, Ungrouped/search leakage, r
estoration, saved account keys, entry replacement, and unload restoration. See `VERIFICATION.md` for
installation and browser validation limits; stubbed component tests do not establish the actual ren
and browser validation limits; stubbed component tests do not establish the actual rendered result.
